req.title: /status/<code> accepts POST
req.statement: The system shall accept POST requests on /status/<code> and return the requested code.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /status/<code> endpoint should accept POST requests and return the requested status code. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to check edge cases around status codes.

tests.name: test_post_status_code_200
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/status/200')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_post_status_code_invalid
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/status/invalid')
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_post_status_code_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/status/299')
assert response.status_code == 299
